name: B10-0583/2025 (PPE) – Arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of two academics jailed in Azerbaijan. Igbal Abilov, a Talysh scholar, was sentenced to 18 years in May 2025. Bahruz Samadov, a PhD student, was sentenced to 15 years in June 2025. Both were tried behind closed doors on treason charges. The Parliament says the charges are politically motivated and that the trials were unfair. It also asks Azerbaijan to allow fair trials and proper medical care.

- The Parliament demands the immediate release of both academics and about 300 other political prisoners.
- It asks Azerbaijan to allow family visits, chosen lawyers and independent medical care, including for Samadov.
- It calls on EU ambassadors in Baku to watch the trials and EU officials to meet the detainees.
